summary: MCP `symbols_pdb_load` and the standalone validator agree on PDB parsing semantics for target/release/rustre.pdb. The 316 vs 424 record-count delta is explained by VA-dedupe in the MCP layer (PUB32+GPROC32 collapse, library-mark propagation) versus raw record enumeration in the validator. Every spot-checked MCP name is present in the validator's name set, GUID/age/version layout are accepted by both, module-info enumeration is consistent, and sanity-check + bad-magic edge cases all pass. No bug surfaced; no crate modification required.
